meta.description: Occupancy statistics, rooms and bookings, exams and invigilation, several campuses, data import: Planner gives school leaders a clear view of the whole school.

entete.titre: The whole school, at a glance.
entete.accroche: School leaders and the registrar's office find rooms, exams and timetable figures in one place.

statistiques.texte: Planner shows how much each room is used and how many hours each teacher carries.

illustration.label: Example statistics screen: room occupancy and teacher workload

quotidien.titre: What the registrar's office manages in Planner.

cartes.texte: Rooms, their capacity, and bookings outside of classes.
Exam sessions, their rooms and their invigilation.
Each campus has its rooms, and travel time between campuses counts in the calculation.
Teachers, students, programmes, groups and courses import from a CSV file.
Everyone has an account and a role: student, teacher or administration.
The school's name, logo and colours appear throughout Planner.
